GILGIT-BALTISTAN DRUGS
GILGIT-BALTISTAN DRUGS
RULES, 2014
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part II,
19th May, 2015]
S.R.O.
423(I)/2015, dated 24-4-2015.---In exercise of the powers conferred under
section 44 of the Drugs Act, 1976 (XXXI of 1976) the Governor of the Gilgit-Baltistan,
in supersession of the Northern Areas Drugs Rules, 1996, is pleased to make the
following rules.
CHAPTER 1
PRELIMINARY
1. Short
title and commencement:
(a) These
rules may be cited as the Gilgit-Baltistan Drugs Rules, 2014.
(b) These,
except application of the Schedule G on the existing licences, shall come into
force at once.
(c) The
Schedule-G, for the existing license, shall come into force after one year from
the date of issuance of this notification.
2. Definition.---(I) in these rules:
(a) "Act"
means the Drugs Act, 1976 (XXXI of 1976);
(b) "Committee"
means a committee of the Board;
(c) "Form"
means form mentioned in the Schedule A;
(d) "Government"
means the Government of the Gilgit-Baltistan.
(e) "Inspector"
means a provincial Inspector appointed under section 17 of the Act.
(f) "Licensing
authority" means the Chief Inspector of Drugs/ Secretary Quality Control
Drugs Gilgit-Baltistan to the Government, Health Department or an officer of
the Government duly authorized by the Licensing Authority;
(g) "Medical
store" means premises where drugs excluding the drugs specified in the
Schedule G are stored, sold or offered for sale;
(h) "Manufacturer"
means a manufacture of a drug;
(i) "Narcotic"
psychotropic or controlled drug" means a drug specified in the Schedule-B
or the Schedule-D;
(j) "Pharmacy"
means premises where drugs are stored, sold, compounded, dispensed or prepared
on prescription;
(k) "Provincial
Board" means the Provincial Quality Control Board;
(l) "Schedule"
means schedule to these rules;
(m) "Section"
means section of the Act; and
(n) "Seller"
means the seller of a drug.
(II) A
word or an expression used in these rules but not defined shall means the same
as defined in the Act.
CHAPTER 2
PROVINCIAL BOARD, GOVERNMENT ANALYST AND INSPECTORS

(2) The board may co-opt any other expert having
formal training as experience in the Pharmaceutical field.
(3) The
quorum to constitute a meeting of the Board shall be three including its
Chairman.
(4) No
act or proceeding of the Board shall be invalid merely on the ground of the
existence of any vacancy in or any defect in the Constitution of the Board.
(5) The
Chief Inspector of Drugs/Secretary Quality Control Drugs Gilgit-Baltistan will
act as Chairman of the board in the absence of the Secretary and Population
Welfare Gilgit-Baltistan.
4. Functions
of the Board.---
(a) An
inspector or a government Analyst shall submit monthly reports on Form-1 and
Form-2 respectively, to the Provincial Quality Control Board and a summary of
overall situation of quality control in his area of jurisdiction, the
Provincial Board shall maintain the information in order to monitor the quality
of all the drugs sold and to review the performance of the manufacturers and
sellers.
